items.description: Report does not give concrete numeric amounts for borrow debt, supplied collateral, or the false surplus, so the relation is symbolic.

Report does not give a numeric definition of net backing (supplied minus borrow) nor a concrete reported_backing value, so the exact inequality relating reported_backing to supplied_collateral minus borrow_debt cannot be derived; the plan binds the qualitative requirement that reported backing not exceed supplied collateral while borrow debt is owed.
